readerCopy.headline: You know what you want and have the nerve to move.
readerCopy.body:
A project can gain momentum without every step feeling like a fight. You may be more willing to make the first move, state what you want, or take on a challenge that requires real effort. Other people may cooperate because the direction is clear and the effort is visible.

Jupiter trine Mars is useful when action already has somewhere to go. Use the momentum for the goal that matters instead of adding three more because the first one is going well. Easy progress can still overfill the week if every success becomes another commitment.
